title: Kwethulwa i-Kyber 0.26
author: Jean-Baptiste Kempf
quote: Sikhipha inguqulo yethu 0.26, enezibuyekezo ezintathu ezinkulu: ibhodi lokunamathisela elithuthukisiwe, i-OpenID Connect nokwenziwa ngcono kokucutshungulwa kwemidiya, kanye nokuthuthukiswa okuncane okuningi.
html:
I-Kyber 0.26 isifikile!

Inguqulo engu-0.26 isiyatholakala.

Le nguqulo iletha ukuqinisekiswa kobunikazi nge-OIDC, intuthuko enkulu ekufakweni kwevidiyo ekhodyini nasekukopisheni nasekunamathiseleni ezinkundleni ezihlukahlukene, nezindlela ezintsha zokuthwebula isikrini ku-Linux. Kulungiswe namaphutha amaningi abethinta ukuzinza kohlelo lwedeskithophu.

Nakhu okugqamile.

Ukuqinisekisa ubunikazi nge-OIDC

Manje usungaqinisekisa ubunikazi nge-OpenID Connect (OIDC) ku-kycontroller nasohlelweni lwe-Kyber lwedeskithophu. Ungaxhumanisa i-Kyber nomhlinzeki wakho wamanje wokuqinisekisa ubunikazi, kungaba yi-Keycloak, i-Auth0, i-Authelia noma olunye uhlelo oluhambisana namazinga obuchwepheshe futhi olukuvumela ukuba ungene ezinhlelweni eziningi ngokungena kanye (SSO).

Leli yigxathu elikhulu ezinhlanganweni ezisebenzisa i-Kyber ezindaweni ezinabasebenzisi abaningi noma ezinkampanini, lapho kudingeka khona ukuphatha ubunikazi babasebenzisi endaweni eyodwa.

Ukukopisha nokunamathisela sekungcono

Amakhompyutha asebenzisa i-X11 ku-Linux manje angabelana ngebhodi lokunamathisela. Ku-Windows, ibhodi lokunamathisela seliyisekela ngokugcwele i-HTML, ngaphezu kombhalo ongenakho ukufometha obuvele usekelwa. Usungakopisha umbhalo onesitayela, izixhumanisi nedatha efomethiwe komunye umshini we-Windows ukunamathisele komunye, njengoba ubungenza emshinini owodwa.

Ukufaka ividiyo ekhodyini sekungcono

I-kymedia isisebenzisa i-FFmpeg 8.1. Lokhu kuletha intuthuko yakamuva ezinhlelweni zokufaka nokukhipha ividiyo ekhodyini, ukulungiswa kwamaphutha nokusebenza okungcono okuvela kubathuthukisi be-FFmpeg.

Kuthuthukiswe kakhulu izilungiselelo zokufaka ividiyo ekhodyini nge-AMF (AMD) nange-VAAPI, kwehla ngokuphawulekayo ukubambezeleka. Abasebenzisi be-AMD yibona abazowuzwa kakhulu umehluko: ukubambezeleka sekucishe kufane nalokho obungakulindela ku-Nvidia.

Ku-Windows, i-kymedia/vlc isisebenzisa i-GUID evamile yakwa-Microsoft uma inciphisa imininingwane yombala ku-HEVC 4:2:2 naku-4:4:4. Lena ithatha indawo yaleyo ebisebenza kumadivayisi akwa-Intel kuphela. Lolu shintsho lusekela amadivayisi ahlukahlukene kakhulu, futhi lusebenza ngokuthembeka okukhulu.

Izindlela ezintsha zokuthwebula isikrini ku-Linux

I-kymedia inezinketho ezimbili ezintsha kusilungiselelo se-grab_backend: i-xcb ne-wlroots. Ku-Linux, isikrini sesingathwetshulwa ngokuqondile ku-X11 naku-wlroots (Wayland), ngakho i-kymedia isisebenza ezindaweni eziningi zedeskithophu.

Isilawuli se-WebSocket sesisebenzisa i-kycom

I-controller/ws ayisaxhumani ngqo ne-kyavserver ne-kynput. Manje isixhumana nazo nge-kycom, njengezinye izingxenye zohlelo.

Ukulungiswa kwamaphutha ukuze uhlelo luzinze

Kulungiswe amaphutha abengavela ezimweni ezingavamile, enze uhlelo luvaleke kungazelelwe, luqale kabusha luphindelela noma lwehluleke ngendlela edidayo:

kycontroller/win32: Uma isithonjana sendawo yezaziso sihluleka ukuvela ekuqaleni, i-Kyber ayisavali. Ibuyela esimweni esivamile lapho ithola umlayezo we-TaskbarCreated, ngakho isebenza kahle ngisho noma i-Explorer iqala kabusha noma ibha yemisebenzi ithatha isikhathi ukuvela.

kyservice/win32: Uma isevisi ithola izilungiselelo ezingavumelekile, ayisaphindaphindi umsebenzi ingaphezi.

kycontroller: Inani lamaklayenti eliboniswa endaweni yezaziso selibuyekezwa ngendlela efanele uma isikhathi seseshini siphela.

kycontroller: Usungakhetha ukuthi isiqaphi sohlelo sisebenze noma singasebenzi.

kycontroller: Kulungiswe ingxenye elawula ukusebenza kwe-RTP. Yayiyeke ukusebenza ngaphandle kwesexwayiso ngemva kokwengezwa kokusekelwa kwe-IPv6 enguqulweni engu-0.25.0.

Amathuluzi okuguqula amakhodi ezinkinobho asekuzo zonke izinkundla

I-kynput manje yenza amathuluzi ayo okuguqula amakhodi ezinkinobho zekhibhodi atholakale kwezinye izinhlelo kuzo zonke izinkundla. Lokhu kusiza abaxhumanisa izinhlelo bakwazi ukuphatha la makhodi ngendlela efanayo kungakhathaliseki ukuthi basebenzisa luphi uhlelo lokusebenza.

Iwebhu: ukubukeka okusha nokuhlelwa kabusha kwezidlali

Isixhumi sewebhu sesinokubukeka okusha kwe-Kyber. Ku-kyctl, izidlali zomsindo nevidiyo sezihlukaniswe zaba amaphakheji azimele e-Rust, okwenza kube lula ukunakekela ikhodi nokuyinweba ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.

Thola inguqulo entsha

I-Kyber 0.26 isiyatholakala. Vakashela ikhasi lokulanda ukuze uthole inguqulo yakamuva, noma uthole amaphakheji abuyekeziwe ngomzila ojwayele ukuwusebenzisa.

Siyayamukela imibono yenu nemibiko yamaphutha.
